claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the machine as Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e and describes it as a large office multifunction copier/printer with scanner bed and paper output tray.
Witness report shows a top scanner bed and multifunction office copier/printer form factor.
Witness report does not show a colour output sample, internal colour components, or a label explicitly stating colour capability.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: no power-on, no print/copy test, so it may have faults, jams, or controller issues.
risks.proof: A short video/clip of powering on, clearing any errors, and producing a test page (copy/print) with the output visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not tested/unknown working condition (worst case: may require service).

risks.risk: High usage / near end-of-life consumables (fuser, drum, toner) not shown; could need expensive replacement soon.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine’s meter/page count screen and a photo showing toner/drum/fuser status or consumable life indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-usage with consumables potentially near end-of-life.

risks.risk: Missing parts or trays: witness notes multiple drawers but does not confirm which trays are included or whether any are missing.
risks.proof: A full photo walkthrough showing all installed trays/finishers (if any) and a checklist of included accessories/parts.
A photo of the connectivity ports panel and a clip showing a successful connection/print from a laptop (screen showing print job success).

risks.risk: Physical wear/damage not assessed: scratches, dents, leaks, worn rollers, or damaged scanner bed not visible in the single angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of scanner glass/rollers, paper feed areas, and any visible wear points (plus a side/back view).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average used condition with potential cosmetic/operational wear.

proof_requests: Power-on and run test: short video showing the machine booting, no error codes, and printing/copying a test page.
Show the page count/meter screen (and any maintenance counters).
Photos of toner/drum/fuser status indicators (or what consumables are included).
Photos of all trays installed and confirm whether any trays/parts are missing; include a side/back view.
Photo of connectivity ports and a clip showing a successful print from a laptop (Ethernet/USB as applicable).
Close-ups of scanner glass/rollers and paper feed areas to check for damage/leaks/worn parts.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the exact model (Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e) and the device type from visible labels and form factor, so it can be priced at worst-case used/untested condition. Working status, meter, consumables, and connectivity are not shown, so the price should assume potential service needs until proven.
